payload.root_cause: In `slugify` (src/text.js:11), the whitespace/dash-collapsing step `.replace(/[\s-]+/, '-')` is missing the global (`g`) regex flag. JavaScript's `String.prototype.replace` with a non-global regex replaces only the first match, so only the first gap between words is converted to a dash; all subsequent runs of spaces (or dashes) are left intact. For 'Hello Big  World!' the pipeline yields 'hello big  world' after cleanup, then only the first single space becomes '-', producing 'hello-big  world' (two spaces before 'world' preserved) instead of 'hello-big-world'. The adjacent regexes in the same chain (lines 10 and 12) correctly use the `g` flag, confirming the omission is the sole cause.
